name: Edgar, Charmed Groom // Edgar Markov's Coffin
clause: // At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 white and black Vampire creature token with lifelink and put a bloodline counter on ~. Then if there are three or more bloodline counters on it, remove those counters and transform it.

needs.proposedSignature: { kind: 'self-has-counters'; counter: string; atLeast?: number }  (extend the existing condition; equivalently a new { kind: 'counters-on-source-ge'; counter: string; value: number })
needs.semantics: True when the source has at least `atLeast` counters of that kind on it, evaluated as the effect applies. Today `self-has-counters` is a name-only >= 1 test and no Condition accepts an Amount, so the very common 'Then if there are N or more <x> counters on it, ...' transform trigger cannot be written at all - any encoding flips the permanent on the first counter. Pairs with the existing removeCounters cost / a negative `counters` amount for the 'remove those counters' half.
needs.clause: Then if there are three or more landmark counters on it, remove those counters, transform ~, and create three Treasure tokens.
